messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alice Porter <alice.porter@acme-corp.com>; Acme SecOps <secops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability export: perimeter handoff & SIEM ingestion checklist

Hi Alice / SecOps team,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Following up with a concrete onramp checklist and a small sample bundle so your ingestion team can validate schema + firewall egress rules. Attached: redwood-export-sample-20280401.tar.gz (contains 72 log lines, mapped fields, and a trace-hook sample).

High-level asks / notes:
- Egress peering: we will push events to your Splunk HEC endpoint over TLS (443). Please confirm your HEC IP allowlist (we will use the export agent’s outbound IPs; sample snippet attached).
- Protocol & auth: HEC token auth; we include an event-level agent header x-rdw-tenant for routing.
- Payload shape: JSON-lines. Example fields: timestamp, service, level, message, trace_id, span_id, sampling.priority. We included a 60s trace hook sample so you can verify correlation.
- Rate/MTU: Our test bundle is deliberately small. For production we recommend initial throttle at 100 req/s and backpressure + 429 handling.
- Redaction & PII: Sensitive fields (user.email, user_ssn) are redacted at the agent; we included a redaction map in the sample.

Next steps suggested:
1) Confirm HEC token & ingest IP allowlist (Alice / Ben)
2) Run the sample bundle and report parsing errors back in this thread
3) One-hour joint test on Wed Apr 3 (I opened a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/priyom-30m)

If you want, Kimberly and Marissa can own the handshake and live debug.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-export-sample-20280401.tar.gz (logbundle, ~2.1MB)]

From: Alice Porter <alice.porter@acme-corp.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability export: perimeter handoff & SIEM ingestion checklist

Priyom, thanks — this is very helpful. Quick answers from our side:
- HEC token: we'll provision a short-lived token (delivery by EOD Tues).
- IP allowlist: currently we can accept 3 /24s via our perimeter; Ben attached a minimal firewall snippet with the required egress ports.
- Parsing: our Splunk team prefers a top-level "event_type" for source routing. Can you add that to the export map?

Also note: our network team imposes stricter TLS ciphers and mTLS for sensitive streams. Is mTLS an option for the HEC endpoint? If not, we may want to tunnel via our forwarder proxy.

Attached: acme-firewall-egress-snippet.txt

I can join Wed in the morning.

-Alice

Priyom / Marissa — thanks for sending the sample. I pulled the bundle and ran it through our local validator. A few concrete remediation items we should address before Wed's test:

1) event_type field: trivial to add at the agent level — will ship a small mapping update and include a compatibility header so we don't break existing consumers.
2) mTLS: Redwood’s export agent supports client certs for private deployments (PKCS12). We’ll prepare cert instructions and an example for Acme to install in the forwarder. If Acme is insisting on mTLS we should plan for the forwarder proxy path so their perimeter doesn't need extra inbound rules.
3) Trace hooking: the trace_id/span_id pair is present but not canonical. I'll normalize to 128-bit hex and include the mapping note in the sample manifest.
4) Backpressure: add Retry-After 120s recommendation and a 429 response handler; we’ll include an example in the runbook.

I can take point on the mapping patch and the cert guide. Marissa — can you produce the brief runbook with the retry/429 guidance and the example Splunk props/transforms for the event_type field?

Priyom — propose the joint run at 09:30 PDT Wed Apr 3; I’ll reserve a dev VM and keep a live chat open in case we need to tail logs.

Thanks,
Kim

  * cert guide and mTLS example (Kim)
  * runbook with 429/backpressure + Splunk props/transforms (Marissa)
